payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate all (n,m) with n*m=t. Deduce zero position from max distance and first non-4i frequency. Validate by comparing frequency array from Manhattan distances.
payload.rationale: Solution is a linear search over divisors, deriving candidate zero coordinates from constraints, then verifying. No DP, no recursive backtracking, but among complete_search options, search_backtracking is the closest generic exhaustive search.
